findings.passage: Efforts to nationalize elections and pass legislation like the SAVE Act risk disenfranchising many married women and threaten the foundational principle that elections are run by the people, not dictated by politicians in Washington. These are clear assaults on democracy and I continue to stand firm with my colleagues to protect the rights of every Michigander,
findings.note: Quoted in a Detroit Caucus press release on the day the state House adopted House Resolution 244 urging Congress to enact the SAVE Act. She says the SAVE Act risks disenfranchising many married women, and that she stands with colleagues against it. She is quoted as caucus secretary.
